event_detail: Kettle: the gripper, fingers already closed on nothing, hovers over the kettle on the counter, dips closer at 17.6 s and rises again at 19.2 s without picking it up.
evidence: Wrist camera shows the kettle standing on the counter below the gripper in all four frames, closest at 17.6 s and further away again at 19.2 s; the finger pads are closed together (empty) in every frame, so the kettle is not held. Shoulder views show the arm reaching over the stove to the right with the kettle still on the counter. No burner is lit. The closed empty gripper suggests an earlier missed grasp; within this clip it is hovering rather than grasping.
